data.content:
Austria enters this matchup unbeaten through four UEFA Nations League matches, with two wins and two draws putting the team at the top of their group. Ralf Rangnick’s side has also been particularly strong at home, avoiding defeat in their last 14 matches as hosts across all competitions. Although Austria drew 2-2 with the Republic of Ireland in October, their attacking approach and home advantage make them a strong candidate to secure all three points. [...] The Republic of Ireland has shown some improvement recently, going unbeaten in their last three Nations League matches. Troy Parrott has been particularly influential, scoring four of the team’s six goals in the competition. However, Ireland has struggled on the road in the Nations League, winning just two of their 12 away matches in the tournament’s history. data.title: International watch: November 2026 - Bristol City FC
data.content:
Jason Knight has been called up to the Republic of Ireland squad as they continue their UEFA Nations League campaign.

The Boys in Green first travel to Linz to face Austria on Saturday, November 14th (7.45pm) before hosting Kosovo in Dublin on Tuesday, November 17th.

Billy O’Neill have been called up the Republic of Ireland squad for their upcoming European Under-19 Championship qualifiers.
